description: Angular service provider class 'PopUpProvider' for managing user interaction alerts, navigation, and Firebase data cleanup in a taxi booking admin web app.

classes.name: PopUpProvider
classes.description: Angular provider class for handling alerts, navigation, and Firebase data operations in a taxi booking admin interface.

methods.name: showAlertNormal
methods.description: Displays a standard alert with a 'Try Again' option, optionally clearing data if network issue.

methods.name: showAlert
methods.description: Displays a simple alert with an 'Okay' button.

methods.name: pickup
methods.description: Prompts user to confirm if they have been picked up, and calls approval method.

methods.name: dropoff
methods.description: Prompts user to confirm arrival at destination and triggers charge process.

methods.name: showPayMentAlert
methods.description: Shows payment-related alert, navigates to RatePage if allowed.

methods.name: showPomp
methods.description: Displays a message alert and clears data on acknowledgment.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a generic alert and resets destination display.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Prompts user to write and send a short message.

methods.name: showEstimateAlert
methods.description: Shows an estimate alert and resets destination UI elements.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Removes customer data from Firebase, resets map and UI state, and clears local storage.

methods.name: locatePosition
methods.description: Placeholder for centering map on given coordinates.

methods.name: presentRouteLoader
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator with a message until dismissed.

methods.name: showAlertComplex
methods.description: Displays a complex alert with checkboxes and accept/reject options, optionally cancels request.
